title: Concept: memcached error detail disclosed in a response
description: A memcached server error reply in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The reply shows the cache protocol is reachable from the request path, so an attacker learns the store and its memory limits.
applicability: Deployments that render a memcached server error reply into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The reply shows the cache protocol is reachable from the request path, so an attacker learns the store and its memory limits.
